# Elysium Home Decor — Complete Digital Showroom Specification

## Overview
Elysium is an artisan minimalist home decor atelier headquartered in Rajkot, Gujarat, operating a 4,500 sq. ft. Display Atelier. The brand crafts earth-bound home objects in unrefined travertine stone, organic stoneware clay, slow-grown white oak, and hand-troweled lime plaster.

## Business Model
Elysium operates strictly on an enquiry-based digital showroom model. There is no online shopping cart or automated checkout. Collectors, interior designers, and architects enquire about pieces directly through WhatsApp (+91 8799587361) or custom enquiry forms.

## Philosophy & Design System
- Purity of Origin: Omitting synthetic coatings, fillers, and chemical glues.
- Wabi-Sabi Aesthetics: Celebrating geomorphic voids, natural fissures, and firing speckles.
- Silent Geometry: Low proportions, continuous physical cuts, and soft light absorption.
- Color Palette: Pure Ink (#000000), Soft Mist (#ECECEC), Pure Paper (#FFFFFF).

## Collection & Products
1. Solis Travertine Console: Super fine Italian travertine stone carved by Sandro Moretti.
2. Caelum Vessel: Unglazed organic stoneware clay hand-turned by Matteo Ghiberti.
3. Estia Pendant Light: Textured lime plaster finish dome light by Eleni Kora.
4. Monolith Lounge Chair: Sculptural white oak timber chair carved by Kenji Yoshino.
5. Terra Plaster Relief: Mineral plaster & volcanic silicate wall sculpture.
6. Aura Alabaster Bowl: Translucent travertine shallow stone bowl by Lorenzo Vane.
7. Chronos Storage Jar: Unglazed organic clay tall storage jar by Dimitris Vance.
8. Nidus Block Stool: Sculptural white oak block stool by Stefan Meyer.
